Vegetative propagation helps in eliminating the virus. 3. Vegetative propagation can be practiced most of the year. Select the correct answer using the code given below.
explanation: • Statement 1 is correct: Vegetative propagation is asexual reproduction, producing clones (genetically identical offspring). • Statement 2 is incorrect: It does not eliminate viruses; infected parent plants transmit viruses to offspring. • Statement 3 is correct: It can be practiced most of the year under suitable conditions, unlike sexual reproduction that depends on specific seasons. • Therefore, statements 1 and 3 are correct. • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Among the following organisms, which one does not belong to the class of other three?
explanation: • Mite, Scorpion, and Spider belong to the class Arachnida (Arachnids). They have eight legs, no antennae, and two body parts. • Crab belongs to Crustacea, which have two pairs of antennae and are typically aquatic. • Thus, Crab does not belong to the same class as the others. • Hence, correct option is (a).

subject: General Science
question: Consider the following: 1. Bats 2. Bears 3. Rodents The phenomenon of hibernation can be observed in which of the above kinds of animals?

options.d: Hibernation cannot be observed in any of the above

explanation: • Hibernation is a state of dormancy and metabolic slowdown during winter to conserve energy when food is scarce. • Bats (1): Many species enter true hibernation, lowering body temperature and metabolism. • Bears (2): Bears undergo a form of winter sleep, with slower metabolism and no food or water intake. • Rodents (3): Many rodents (like hamsters, ground squirrels, and woodchucks) are true hibernators. • Hence, all three show hibernation. • Therefore, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: H1N1 virus is sometimes mentioned in the news with reference to which one of the following diseases?
explanation: • The H1N1 virus is a subtype of the Influenza A virus. • It became globally significant in 2009, when a new strain of the virus emerged and caused a pandemic. • This strain was a novel reassortment of human, avian (bird), and swine (pig) influenza viruses. • • • • • Because it contained genetic material from influenza viruses that circulate in pigs, it was commonly referred to as “swine flu.” AIDS (a) is caused by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV). Bird flu (b) refers to influenza caused by avian influenza viruses such as H5N1. Dengue (c) is caused by the dengue virus, which is transmitted by mosquitoes. Hence, correct option is (d).

subject: General Science
question: In eye donation, which one of the following parts of donor's eye is utilised?
explanation: • In eye donation, it is not the entire eyeball that is transplanted — only the cornea is used to restore sight. • The cornea is the transparent, dome-shaped outer layer at the front of the eye that focuses light as it enters. • A corneal transplant (keratoplasty) replaces a damaged or cloudy cornea with a healthy one from a donor. • The iris (a), lens (b), and retina (d) are not transplanted in standard eye donation procedures. • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Which one of the following genetic diseases is sex-linked?
explanation: • Royal haemophilia (Haemophilia A) is a classic X-linked recessive disorder caused by a defective gene on the X chromosome. • • • • Since males (XY) have only one X chromosome, they are more likely to express the disorder. Females (XX) usually act as carriers. Tay-Sachs disease (b) and Cystic fibrosis (c) are autosomal recessive diseases. Hypertension (d) is a multifactorial condition influenced by both genes and environment, not sex-linked. Hence, correct option is (a).

subject: General Science
question: Neem tree has acquired industrial importance as a source of

options.b: anti-fertility compound, biofertilizer and anticancer drug

explanation: • The Neem tree (Azadirachta indica) is valuable for its bioactive compounds extracted from leaves, seeds, and bark. • Biopesticide: Contains azadirachtin, a powerful insect repellent and growth disruptor, used widely in organic farming. • Biofertilizer: Neem cake (residue after oil extraction) acts as an organic manure, enriching soil and protecting roots from pests. • Anti-fertility compound: Neem oil has shown spermicidal and anti-fertility properties, studied for natural contraceptive use. • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Lathyrism is caused by excessive consumption of
explanation: • Lathyrism is a neurological disorder causing paralysis of the lower limbs. • It results from consumption of Kesari dal (Lathyrus sativus), which contains the • • neurotoxin ODAP (β-N-Oxalyl-L-α,βdiaminopropionic acid). Prolonged intake, especially during droughts or famines, leads to irreversible nerve damage. Hence, correct option is (a).

subject: General Science
question: Barium in a suitable form is administered to patients before an X-ray examination of the stomach, because

options.a: barium allows X-rays to pass through the stomach on account of its transparency to X-rays
options.b: barium compound, like magnesium sulphate helps in cleaning the stomach before X-ray examination
options.c: barium is a good absorber of X-rays and this helps the stomach to appear clearly in contrast with the other regions in the picture
options.d: barium salts are white in colour and this helps the stomach to appear clearly in contrast with other regions in the picture

explanation: • Barium sulfate is used as a radiocontrast agent in X-rays of the digestive tract. • It is a good absorber (radiopaque) of X-rays due to its high atomic number, making the stomach and intestines visible. • The barium meal coats the inner lining, creating a white outline on X-rays for better diagnosis. • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: When ants bite, they inject
explanation: • Many ants inject formic acid (methanoic acid) as a defense chemical. • The term “formic” is derived from Formica, Latin for ant. • It causes pain, itching, and swelling upon bites. • Acetic acid (a) is found in vinegar, methanol (b) is an alcohol, and stearic acid (d) is a fatty acid. Hence, correct option is (c). •

subject: General Science
question: Which one of the following is a useful functional association between fungi and the roots of higher plants?
explanation: • Mycorrhiza is a mutualistic association between fungi and plant roots. • The fungus increases absorption of water and minerals (especially phosphorus). • The plant provides carbohydrates to the fungus. • Biofertilizer (a) is a general term; Coralloid roots (b) associate with cyanobacteria, and Lichen (c) involves fungus + algae/cyanobacteria, not roots. • Hence, correct option is (d). • •

subject: General Science
question: Match the hormones in List I with items in List II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the Lists: List I A. Adrenaline B. Estrogen C. Insulin D. Pheromones List II 1. Anger, Fear, Danger 2. Attracting partners of smell through sense 3. Females 4. Glucose Codes: ABCD
explanation: • • • • A. Adrenaline → (1): Triggers “fight or flight” response; linked to anger, fear, danger. B. Estrogen → (3): Primary female sex hormone responsible for female reproductive traits. C. Insulin → (4): Regulates glucose metabolism by enabling cells to absorb sugar. D. Pheromones → (2): Chemical messengers used for attracting mates via smell. Hence, the correct match is A–1, B–3, C–4, D– 2. Therefore, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) is a standard criterion for

options.b: Computing oxygen levels in forest ecosystems
options.d: Assessing oxygen levels in high altitude regions

explanation: • Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) measures the amount of dissolved oxygen required by aerobic microorganisms to decompose organic matter in a water sample. • It is a standard test used to assess the organic pollution level in aquatic ecosystems. • High BOD means high organic pollution, indicating that microorganisms are consuming more oxygen to break down waste, reducing oxygen available for aquatic life. • Thus, high BOD = poor water quality and low BOD = cleaner water. • It is not used for measuring oxygen in blood (a), forest ecosystems (b), or high altitudes (d). • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Consider the following statements: 1. In tropical regions, Zika virus disease is transmitted by the same mosquito that transmits dengue. 2. Sexual transmission of Zika virus disease is possible. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: • Statement 1 is correct: Zika virus is transmitted primarily by the Aedes mosquito (Aedes aegypti) — the same species responsible for spreading dengue, chikungunya, and yellow fever in tropical regions. • Statement 2 is correct: Apart from mosquito transmission, Zika virus can also be transmitted sexually, as the virus can persist in semen for several weeks after infection. • Both statements are scientifically verified facts. • Hence, correct option is (c).

subject: General Science
question: Solar eclipse occurs when

options.a: Earth comes between sun and moon
options.b: Moon is at right angle to the earth
options.c: Moon comes between sun and earth
options.d: Sun comes between moon and earth

explanation: • A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes directly between the Sun and Earth. • When this alignment happens, the Moon’s shadow falls on the Earth, blocking sunlight partially or completely. • It can occur only during the New Moon phase. • Hence, option (c) is correct. •

subject: General Science
question: When a man circles round the earth in a satellite, then

options.a: His mass becomes zero but weight remains constant
options.b: Mass remains constant but weight becomes zero
options.c: Both mass and weight remain constant
options.d: Both mass and weight remain zero

explanation: • Mass is an intrinsic property and remains constant regardless of location. • Weight depends on gravitational pull (Weight = mass × gravity). • In a satellite, a man is in continuous freefall, creating a state of weightlessness. • His apparent weight becomes zero, even though gravity still acts on him. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The weight of an object at the poles is greater than at the equator. This is because

options.a: Of the shape of the earth
options.b: The attraction of the moon is maximum at the earth's surface
options.c: The attraction of the sun is maximum at the earth's surface
options.d: Gravitational pull is more at the poles

explanation: • • • The Earth is an oblate spheroid, flattened at poles and bulging at the equator. Therefore, the distance to Earth's center is smaller at poles. By Newton’s law of gravitation, gravity increases with decreasing distance. Hence, gravitational pull is stronger at the poles. Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The water in an open pond remains cool even in hot summer because

options.b: Water radiates heat more rapidly than the atmosphere
options.c: Water absorbs heat less rapidly than the atmosphere
options.d: Water absorbs heat more rapidly than the atmosphere

explanation: • Evaporation is a cooling process where highenergy molecules escape as vapor. • This removes heat from the remaining water, lowering its temperature. • Though water’s high specific heat slows heating, evaporation is the dominant cooling effect. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: You are travelling in a car and a thunderstorm suddenly takes place. What will be your first step?

options.a: Stop the car, get out of it and lie flat in the field
options.c: Go to a nearby wooden pole and stick to it

explanation: • A car’s metal body acts as a Faraday cage, conducting lightning around passengers safely. • Safest action: stay inside, pull over, and avoid touching metal parts. • Options (a), (b), and (c) increase lightning risk. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: In high mountain regions bleeding through the nose occurs because

options.a: The pressure of the blood capillaries is higher than the outside pressure
options.b: The pressure at high altitudes is greater than that in the plains
options.c: The blood pressure increases at high altitudes
options.d: The blood pressure decreases at high altitudes

explanation: • At high altitudes, atmospheric pressure is lower. • Internal blood pressure remains relatively constant, creating a pressure difference. • This causes capillaries to rupture, leading to nosebleeds. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: When light enters a closed room through a small hole in the door, the image of an outside building appears inverted on the opposite wall. This is because

options.a: The hole acts as a convex lens
options.b: Light takes a curvature at the edges of the hole
options.d: The hole acts as a concave lens

explanation: • This is the principle of a pinhole camera. • Light travels in straight lines — called rectilinear propagation. • Light from the top of the object travels to the bottom of the wall, and vice versa. • This crossing of rays produces an inverted image. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: An ordinary clock loses time in summer. This is because

options.a: The length of the pendulum increases and the time period increases
options.b: The length of the pendulum increases and the time period decreases
options.c: The length of the pendulum decreases and the time period increases
options.d: The length of the pendulum decreases and the time period decreases

explanation: • In summer, metal expands, increasing the pendulum’s length. • The time period (T ∝ √l) therefore increases. • Each swing takes slightly longer, so the clock runs slow. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A ball bounces higher at high altitudes than in plains. This is because

options.a: The air pressure on higher altitudes is lower than that in plains
options.b: Downward pull due to gravity is less at higher altitudes
options.c: The rarefied air offers less resistance to the ball
options.d: You become more energetic at hills, so greater the force applied, higher goes the ball

explanation: • At high altitudes, air is rarefied and less dense. • Therefore, air resistance is lower, so the ball loses less energy. • It bounces higher compared to plains. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The minor planets revolving between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter are called
explanation: • Asteroids are rocky bodies orbiting the Sun, mainly between Mars and Jupiter. • Comets are icy bodies, meteors are burning debris, and novas are stellar explosions. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Range of Television Broadcasting is confined to a limited distance because

options.b: Short waves are absorbed by the atmosphere
options.c: Energy of the waves is dissipated

explanation: • Television broadcasting uses VHF (Very High Frequency) and UHF (Ultra High Frequency) waves. • These waves travel in straight lines — known as line-of-sight propagation. • Because the Earth is spherical, the curvature blocks these signals beyond the horizon. • Thus, the broadcasting range is limited by Earth's curvature. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Unit of distance used in navigation is
explanation: • Nautical mile is the standard unit used in marine and air navigation. • It is based on Earth’s circumference and equals one minute of latitude. • 1 nautical mile = 1,852 meters. • Kilometre is used on land, light year for space, and yard is an imperial unit. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: What type of mirror is used by motorists to see the road behind them?
explanation: • Convex mirrors curve outward and produce virtual, upright, and diminished images. • They offer a wider field of view, helping drivers see more area behind. • Used in rear-view mirrors to minimize blind spots. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The escape velocity from the earth's surface is about
explanation: • Escape velocity is the minimum speed needed to break free from Earth’s gravity. • For Earth, it is approximately 11.2 km/s (≈ 40,270 km/h). • Objects launched at this speed will not fall back to Earth. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The radiant energy of the sun is due to
explanation: • The Sun’s energy comes from nuclear fusion in its core. • Hydrogen nuclei fuse to form helium, releasing enormous energy. • This follows Einstein’s equation E = mc². • Nuclear fission occurs in reactors, not in the Sun. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: In a microphone, transformation of energy takes place from
explanation: • A microphone is a transducer converting sound waves into electrical signals. • Sound vibrations move a diaphragm, creating electric variations. • This forms the basis of audio recording and communication. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Fuel used in a nuclear reactor is
explanation: • Uranium-235 is the most common fuel used in nuclear reactors. • It is a fissile material, splitting to release large amounts of energy. • Heavy water acts as a moderator, cadmium as a control rod, and barium is a by-product. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Neil Armstrong was the first person to reach the moon. While walking on the moon

options.a: His mass remained the same but weight increased
options.b: His mass remained the same but weight decreased
options.c: His mass as well as weight decreased
options.d: His mass increased but weight remained the same

explanation: • Mass is the amount of matter, which remains constant anywhere. • Weight depends on gravitational force. • The Moon’s gravity is about 1/6th of Earth’s, so his weight decreased accordingly. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Distance of stars is measured in
explanation: • Light-year is the standard unit for measuring astronomical distances. • It is the distance light travels in one year = 9.46 trillion km. • Kilometres or nautical miles are too small for cosmic scales. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Isotopes of the same element differ in the number of
explanation: • Isotopes have the same number of protons but different neutrons. • This causes a difference in mass number, not in chemical properties. • Example: Carbon-12 and Carbon-14 differ by two neutrons. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Stainless steel contains which of the following?
explanation: • Stainless steel is an iron alloy containing carbon and at least 10.5% chromium. • Chromium oxide layer prevents rusting and corrosion. • Nickel may be added to increase strength and shine. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Radar is used for

options.a: Detecting objects by using light waves
options.b: Reflecting sound waves to detect objects
options.c: Determining the presence and location of objects with radio waves

explanation: • RADAR stands for Radio Detection and Ranging. • It uses radio waves to detect distance, angle, and speed of objects. • It works by transmitting waves and receiving their reflections (echoes). • Weather radar is one of its applications. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: In a hydraulic device as shown in the figure, how much weight should be put on the piston A to balance the level of water when a weight of 40 gm is put on the piston B?
explanation: • This question is based on Pascal's Principle, which states that pressure applied to an enclosed fluid is transmitted undiminished to every portion of the fluid and the walls of the containing vessel. • In a hydraulic system, the pressure on both pistons is equal: P₁ = P₂. • Pressure (P) is defined as Force (F) per unit Area (A), so F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂. • Let's assume the diameter of piston A is 'd', so its radius is r = d/2 and its area is A₁ = π(d/2)² = πd²/4. • The diameter of piston B is twice that of A, so its diameter is '2d', its radius is r = d, and its area is A₂ = π(d)² = πd². • We are given the weight (force) on piston B, F₂ = 40 g. We need to find the weight on piston A, F₁. • Using the formula: F₁ / (πd²/4) = 40 / (πd²). • Simplifying, we get F₁ = (40 * πd²/4) / πd² = 40 / 4 = 10 g. (Note: The provided answer key says (c) 20g, which is incorrect based on the principles of hydraulics. The force is proportional to the area, and since the area • of B is 4 times the area of A, the

subject: General Science
question: To check a thermometer, the boiling point of water should be recorded as shown in the figure:
explanation: • To accurately measure the temperature of a substance, the sensing part of the thermometer (the bulb) must be fully immersed in the substance being measured. • In this case, to measure the boiling point of water, the thermometer’s bulb must be placed in the boiling water itself, not just in the steam above it. • In figure (c), the bulb of the thermometer is correctly and fully immersed in the boiling water, which will give the most accurate reading of the boiling point. • In (a) and (b), the bulb is only in the steam, which might not be at the exact boiling temperature. In (d), the bulb is touching the bottom of the beaker, which could be hotter than the water itself. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: To an astronaut in the spacecraft, the sky colour appears to be
explanation: • • • • The sky appears blue on Earth because of Rayleigh scattering. The Earth's atmosphere contains tiny molecules that scatter shortwavelength light (blue and violet) more effectively than long-wavelength light. In space, outside the Earth's atmosphere, there are no atmospheric particles to scatter the sunlight. Without this scattering, an astronaut in a spacecraft sees the Sun as a brilliant, white star against the void of space, which appears completely black. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A new temperature scale has been devised according to which water freezes at 40°X and boils at 240°X. The relationship between Xelsius and Celsius scale is best expressed by the graph
explanation: • This question asks for the graphical representation of the relationship between two linear temperature scales: Celsius (°C) and the new Xelsius (°X). • We know the following corresponding points: Freezing point of water: 0°C = 40°X; Boiling point of water: 100°C = 240°X. • Since the relationship between two linear scales is a straight line, we can plot these two points. The line must pass through (0, 40) and (100, 240). • Graph (I) shows a negative slope. • Graph (II) starts from the origin (0,0). • Graph (III) correctly shows a straight line that starts at a positive value on the Y-axis (40°X) • • when the X-axis (Celsius) is at 0, and then rises linearly. This matches our points. Graph (IV) shows a curve, which is incorrect for a linear relationship. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: On the above scale, the average body temperature of 98.4°F will be equivalent to
explanation: • First, we need to establish the conversion formula between Celsius (°C) and Xelsius (°X). A general formula for converting between two linear scales is: (Temp₂ - Point A₂) / (Point B₂ Point A₂) = (Temp₁ - Point A₁) / (Point B₁ Point A₁). • Let's use the freezing and boiling points of water: (°X - 40) / (240 - 40) = (°C - 0) / (100 0). • (°X - 40) / 200 = °C / 100. • °X - 40 = 2 * °C => °X = 2 * °C + 40. • Next, convert the given Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius: °C = (°F - 32) * 5/9. • °C = (98.4 - 32) * 5/9 = 66.4 * 5/9 = 36.89°C (approximately 37°C). • Now, convert this Celsius temperature to Xelsius using our formula: °X = 2 * (36.89) + 40 = 73.78 + 40 = 113.78°X. • This value is closest to 113.3°X. (Note: The calculation in the provided answer key is flawed. It incorrectly assumes a direct proportional relationship from 0°F, which is not how temperature scales work). • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: What are the primary colours?
explanation: • • • • • The question is ambiguous as there are two sets of primary colors: additive and subtractive. Additive primary colors are used when mixing light (like on a computer screen or TV). These are Red, Green, and Blue (RGB). Mixing them produces white light. This is the standard definition in physics. Subtractive primary colors are used when mixing pigments (like paint or ink). These are traditionally taught as Red, Yellow, and Blue (RYB), although the more accurate set used in printing is Cyan, Magenta, and Yellow (CMY). Mixing these absorbs light, producing black. Given the common scientific context of these questions, Red, Blue, and Green (RGB) is the most appropriate answer for the primary colors of light. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: If water contracts on freezing, which of the following would happen?

options.a: Icebergs will completely float on the surface of water
options.c: Lakes would freeze from top to bottom
options.d: Rocks will crack due to freezing of internal water

explanation: • This is a hypothetical question. In reality, water expands when it freezes, making ice less dense than liquid water. • Density is mass per unit volume. If water were to contract (decrease in volume) upon freezing, its mass would be packed into a smaller space. • This would mean that ice would become more dense than liquid water. • As a consequence, ice would sink instead of float (ruling out a), and lakes would freeze from the bottom up instead of top-down (ruling out c). Cracking rocks (d) is a result of water expanding upon freezing, so this would not happen. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: When the ice floating in a glass of water melts, the level of water will
explanation: • This is a classic physics problem based on Archimedes' principle. • A floating object displaces a volume of fluid that has a weight equal to the object's own weight. • An ice cube is just frozen water. The volume of water it displaces while floating has the same weight as the ice cube itself. • When the ice cube melts, it turns into a volume of liquid water that has exactly the same weight. • Therefore, the melted water exactly fills the volume that the ice cube was displacing, and the overall water level will remain constant. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: What is the function of a fuse wire?

options.a: To prevent an unduly high electric current from passing through a circuit

explanation: • A fuse wire is a safety device designed to protect an electrical circuit from excessive current. • It is made of a metal alloy with a low melting point and is placed in series with the circuit it protects. • If the current in the circuit exceeds a safe level (due to a short circuit or overload), the fuse wire heats up, melts, and breaks the circuit. • This stops the flow of electricity and prevents an unduly high electric current from damaging the appliance or causing a fire. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Why is it advisable not to draw current for many appliances from a single point?

options.c: Current and voltage both will increase
options.d: Voltage will decrease whereas current will increase

explanation: • When you plug multiple appliances into a single outlet or power strip, you are connecting them in parallel to the main power supply. • In a parallel circuit, the total current drawn from the source is the sum of the currents drawn by each individual appliance (I_total = I₁ + I₂ + I₃ + ...). This means the total current will increase as you add more appliances. • However, all electrical wiring has some internal resistance. As the total current increases, the voltage drop across the house wiring (V = I * R_wiring) also increases. This causes the voltage available at the outlet to decrease. • This combination of increased current and decreased voltage can overload the circuit, cause wires to overheat, and damage the appliances. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Why does a man weigh more at the poles than at the equator?

options.a: Because there is no atmosphere at the poles
options.b: Because gravitational pull is more at the poles
options.c: Because gravitational pull is less at the poles

explanation: • This is similar to Q3 from 1979. A person's weight depends on the force of gravity. • The Earth is an oblate spheroid, meaning the polar radius is shorter than the equatorial radius. This places the surface at the poles closer to the Earth's center of mass. • Due to the inverse square law of gravitation, the gravitational pull is stronger (more) at the poles. • • • Additionally, the centrifugal force caused by the Earth's rotation is maximum at the equator and zero at the poles. This outward force slightly counteracts gravity at the equator, making the effective gravity weaker there. Both effects combine to make a person weigh more at the poles. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Mark the correct answer

options.a: Planets have an apparent motion and twinkle
options.b: Planets have no apparent motion but twinkle
options.c: Planets have an apparent motion but do not twinkle
options.d: Planets have no apparent motion and do not twinkle

explanation: • Apparent Motion: Planets, being part of our solar system, orbit the Sun just as Earth does. From our perspective, they appear to move against the background of distant, "fixed" stars. This wandering motion is their apparent motion. • Twinkling: Stars are so far away that they appear as single points of light. As this point of light passes through Earth's turbulent atmosphere, it is refracted multiple times, causing it to twinkle. • Planets, being much closer, appear as tiny disks of light, not single points. The light from this disk averages out as it passes through the atmosphere, so they do not twinkle and shine with a steady light. • Therefore, planets have an apparent motion but do not twinkle. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Why is it easier to cook in a pressure cooker?

options.b: More steam is formed inside the cooker
options.c: Boiling point of water is raised
options.d: Boiling point of water is lowered

explanation: • • • • • • A pressure cooker is a sealed pot that does not allow steam to escape. As the water inside heats up and turns to steam, the pressure inside the cooker builds up to a level higher than the normal atmospheric pressure. The boiling point of a liquid increases as the pressure above it increases. Inside the pressure cooker, water boils at a temperature significantly higher than its normal 100°C (e.g., around 121°C). Cooking food at this higher temperature significantly speeds up the chemical reactions involved in cooking, making it much faster and easier. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: What happens when the temperature of water falls from 30°C to 0°C?

options.a: The volume of ice formed will be less than the volume of water
options.b: The volume of ice formed will be more than the volume of water

explanation: • This question describes the process of water cooling and freezing. • Water exhibits an anomalous expansion. As it cools, it contracts and becomes denser until it reaches its maximum density at 4°C. • As it cools further from 4°C to 0°C, it begins to expand and become less dense. • Upon freezing at 0°C, it undergoes a significant expansion. The crystalline structure of ice takes up more space than the molecules in liquid water. • Therefore, a given mass of water will have a larger volume as ice. The volume of ice formed will be more than the volume of the water it came from. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: To an astronaut in the spacecraft, the sky appears to be
explanation: • The sky on Earth appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, where the molecules in the atmosphere scatter short-wavelength light (like blue and violet) more effectively than long-wavelength light. • In space, there is no atmosphere to scatter the sunlight. • Without this scattering effect, an astronaut in a spacecraft sees the Sun as a bright star against the vacuum of space, which appears completely dark or black. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A fan makes a hot noon feel cool by
explanation: • A fan does not actually cool the air in a room; in fact, its motor adds a small amount of heat. • The cooling sensation we feel is caused by the moving air from the fan increasing the rate of evaporation of sweat from our skin. • Evaporation is a cooling process because it requires energy (heat) to change liquid sweat into water vapor. By accelerating this process, the fan helps our body lose heat more efficiently, making us feel cooler. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: When a ship enters a sea from a river, its portion under water will
explanation: • This phenomenon is explained by Archimedes' principle and the concept of density. • Sea water is denser than fresh river water because of its dissolved salt content. • According to Archimedes' principle, a floating object (the ship) displaces a weight of fluid equal to its own weight. • Since the ship's weight is constant, it needs to displace a smaller volume of the denser sea water to support its weight compared to the larger volume of less dense river water. • Therefore, when a ship moves from a river to the sea, it will float higher, and the portion of its hull under water will decrease. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Hygrometer is used to measure
explanation: • A hygrometer is an instrument used for measuring the amount of water vapor in the air, in soil, or in confined spaces. • It specifically measures the relative humidity of the atmosphere, which is the ratio of the actual amount of water vapor in the air to the maximum amount it could hold at that temperature. • An instrument used to measure the density of a liquid is called a hydrometer. (Note: The provided answer key says (a), which is incorrect. A hygrometer measures humidity). • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Kilowatt is the unit of
explanation: • The fundamental unit of power in the International System of Units (SI) is the Watt (W). Power is the rate at which energy is used or work is done. • A kilowatt (kW) is a multiple of the watt. "Kilo" is the prefix for one thousand. • Therefore, one kilowatt is equal to 1,000 watts. It is a unit of power, commonly used to express the output of engines or the power consumption of electrical devices. (Note: The provided explanation incorrectly describes a kilowatt-hour, which is a unit of energy, not power). • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The sun derives its energy from
explanation: • The immense energy produced by the Sun is the result of nuclear fusion reactions occurring in its extremely hot and dense core. • In this process, hydrogen nuclei (protons) are fused together under immense pressure and temperature to form helium nuclei. • During this fusion, a small amount of mass is converted into a tremendous amount of energy, as described by E=mc². This energy radiates outwards, providing light and heat to the solar system. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A man starts from a certain point O and follows the route as shown in the graph. Which of the following statements is correct? • •

options.a: He travels with a uniform velocity throughout
options.b: He travels with a greater velocity from O to A than from A to B
options.c: He travels with a greater velocity from A to B than from O to A
options.d: He returns to the original point with a non-uniform velocity

explanation: • The graph shows Distance on the y-axis and Time on the x-axis. Velocity is represented by the slope (steepness) of the line on a distance-time graph. • From O to A, the man travels a certain distance in a given time, represented by the slope of the line segment OA. • From A to B, the man travels a larger distance in a shorter amount of time. The line segment AB is steeper than the line segment OA. • A steeper slope indicates a greater velocity. Therefore, the man travels with a greater velocity from A to B than from O to A. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Electrodes are used in Voltaic cells. These are of:
explanation: • A classic example of a voltaic cell (or galvanic cell) is the Daniell cell. • This cell uses an electrode made of zinc (the anode, where oxidation occurs) placed in a zinc sulfate solution, and an electrode made of copper (the cathode, where reduction occurs) placed in a copper sulfate solution. The difference in the electrochemical potential between the zinc and copper electrodes drives the flow of electrons, generating an electric current. This combination is a fundamental demonstration of how a voltaic cell works. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: What is the difference between an explosion and combustion?

options.a: In the former nuclear reaction takes place while in the latter case burning takes place
options.b: In the former chemical energy is transformed into nuclear energy while in the latter case the chemical energy is transformed into heat energy
options.c: In the former it is a violent and rapid reaction with the release of much heat energy while in the latter case it is generally a slow reaction with the release of less heat energy

explanation: • Combustion is a chemical process that releases energy in the form of heat and light. It is essentially burning. • While it can be rapid (like in a fire), it is generally a controlled or slower process compared to an explosion. • An explosion is a type of combustion that occurs extremely rapidly, producing a large volume of hot gas in a very short time. • This rapid expansion of gas creates a shockwave and is characterized by its violent and rapid nature, releasing a large amount of energy almost instantaneously. • Therefore, the key difference is the speed and violence of the reaction — an explosion is a very fast, violent form of combustion. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Assertion (A): The same side of the moon is always seen from the earth. Reason (R): The moon rotates on its axis once in each orbital revolution.

options.a: If both A and R are true but R is not the reason for A
options.b: If both A and R are true and R is the reason for A
options.c: If neither A nor R is correct
options.d: If A is correct but R is wrong

explanation: • Assertion (A) is true — from our perspective on Earth, we always see the same face of the Moon, a phenomenon known as synchronous rotation or tidal locking. • Reason (R) is also true — the Moon completes one rotation on its axis in approximately the same amount of time it takes to complete one orbit around the Earth (about 27.3 days). • R is the correct explanation of A, because the Moon’s rotation period perfectly matches its orbital period, so the same hemisphere constantly faces Earth. • This synchronous rotation is the direct cause of the phenomenon described in the assertion. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: "Mach Number" is a term associated with the speed of
explanation: • Mach number is a dimensionless quantity in fluid dynamics, representing the ratio of the speed of an object moving through a fluid to the local speed of sound in that fluid. • It is most commonly used to describe the speed of high-speed aircraft, such as jets and rockets. • For example, Mach 1 is the speed of sound, and an aircraft flying at Mach 2 is traveling at twice the speed of sound. • • This term is crucial in aerodynamics and is almost exclusively associated with the speed of aeroplanes and aerospace vehicles. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Why do we feel chill after having a dip in sea water?

options.a: The difference in temperature between sea water and the atmosphere
options.b: Evaporation of water from the body
options.c: Deposition of salt on the body

explanation: • The primary reason for feeling a chill after getting out of water is the process of evaporation. • For the water on your skin to evaporate (turn from a liquid to a gas), it needs energy in the form of heat. • This heat energy is drawn from your body, causing your skin temperature to drop and making you feel cold. • This process is known as evaporative cooling or the wind-chill effect. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The surface of the water in a lake is frozen and its temperature is -15°C. The maximum possible temperature of the water inside the lake in contact with the ice layer will be
explanation: • The layer of water directly in contact with the underside of the ice must be at the freezing/melting point of water. • The freezing point of fresh water is 0°C, so the water just below the ice will be at 0°C. • Deeper water below this layer might be warmer (up to 4°C), where water reaches its maximum density, but the layer immediately touching the ice is always 0°C. Hence, option (a) is correct. (Note: The provided key says (b), but that refers to water at the lake bottom, not in contact with the ice layer.) •

subject: General Science
question: A stone is tied to a rope and attached to a wooden bar which rotates at a constant angular velocity. Suddenly the bar is stopped. The stone gets encircled around the bar. What happens to the angular velocity of the stone?
explanation: • This is an example of the conservation of angular momentum. • Angular momentum (L) = I × ω, where I is the moment of inertia and ω is the angular velocity. • When the bar stops, the rope begins to wrap around it, causing the radius (r) of the stone’s circular path to decrease. • Since I = m × r², a smaller radius means a smaller moment of inertia (I). • With no external torque, L remains constant, so if I decreases, ω must increase. • Hence, option (a) is correct. • • •

subject: General Science
question: The cover of a solar cooker is made of glass. Why?

options.c: Sun heat is transmitted through glass without much absorption

explanation: • • • • A solar cooker works by trapping heat from the sun — this is the greenhouse effect. The glass cover is transparent to shortwavelength visible light, allowing sunlight to enter the cooker. This light is absorbed by the dark interior and cooking pot, which heats up. The heated interior re-radiates longwavelength infrared radiation, which the glass does not let escape easily. Thus, the glass transmits sunlight but traps heat inside. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: When a brick is dropped in water, bubbles are seen to rise. This is due to

options.a: Air in the pores of the brick

explanation: • Bricks are porous materials containing many tiny air-filled spaces. • When a dry brick is dropped into water, the water seeps into these pores, displacing the trapped air. • This air escapes to the surface in the form of bubbles. • The displacement of water (option c) does occur but does not cause the rising air bubbles. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which comet appears after 76 years and likely to appear in 1986?
explanation: • • • • • Halley’s Comet is the most famous periodic comet, visible from Earth every 75–76 years. It is the only short-period comet regularly visible to the naked eye and can appear twice in a lifetime. Its appearances have been recorded since 240 BC. It last appeared in 1986 and will return around 2061. Hence, option (a) is correct. • The jerk is due to the Law of Inertia (Newton’s First Law of Motion). • When the bus is moving, the passenger’s body is also in motion. • When the bus suddenly stops, the lower part of the body stops, but the upper part continues moving due to inertia. • This causes the person to jerk forward. Hence option a is correct.

subject: General Science
question: For pasteurization by the Flash Method, milk is heated to a temperature of
explanation: • Pasteurization is a process of heating a liquid to a specific temperature for a predefined time and then rapidly cooling it to slow microbial growth. • The Flash Method, also known as HighTemperature Short-Time (HTST) pasteurization, is the most common modern method. • In this method, milk is heated to 72°C (161.5°F) for 15 seconds, followed by rapid cooling. • This method kills harmful bacteria while maintaining the taste and nutrition of milk. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Halley’s comet has to appear in the solar family in the year
explanation: • Halley’s Comet is a periodic comet, returning approximately every 75–76 years. • It has been observed for centuries and is one of the most famous celestial phenomena. • • Its most recent appearance was in 1986, and the next one is expected in 2061. Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Mesons are found in
explanation: • Mesons are unstable subatomic particles composed of one quark and one antiquark. • They are not found naturally on Earth but are produced during high-energy particle interactions. • Cosmic rays, which are high-energy particles from outer space, collide with atmospheric particles and produce secondary particles, including mesons (like pions and kaons). • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Study the frequency of the following electromagnetic radiations and select the correct relationship ('>' implies greater than): I. Infra-red II. Microwave III. Ultra-violet Codes:
explanation: • The electromagnetic spectrum is arranged (by increasing frequency) as: Radio waves → Microwaves → Infra-red → Visible → Ultra-violet → X-rays → Gamma rays. • Among the given: o Microwave (II) = lowest frequency o Infra-red (I) = higher frequency than microwaves o Ultra-violet (III) = highest frequency of all three • • Therefore, III > I > II (Ultra-violet > Infra-red > Microwave). Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Given: Humidity – H Wind Velocity – W Temperature – T High – A Low – B The desert cooler is an appropriate cooling device for regions where
explanation: • A desert cooler works on the principle of evaporative cooling. • It is most efficient when: o Humidity (H) is Low (B) — dry air allows faster evaporation. o Temperature (T) is High (A) — more heat available to evaporate water. o Wind Velocity (W) is High (A) — ensures air circulation and cool air distribution. • These conditions — low humidity, high wind, high temperature — are typical of arid regions. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Black hole is
explanation: • A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so intense that nothing can escape, not even light. • It is formed when a massive star exhausts its fuel and its core collapses under its own gravity. • • • This collapse leads to an object of infinite density and zero volume, creating an event horizon from which no light escapes. Thus, a black hole is the final stage of a dying massive star. Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Ball-bearings are used to reduce the friction by

options.a: Reducing the area of contact with the use of metallic balls
options.b: Increasing the area of contact with the use of metallic balls
options.c: Applying lubricants to the balls used

explanation: • Ball bearings are used to reduce friction between moving parts. • They do so by replacing sliding friction with rolling friction, which is much smaller. • The metallic balls create a very small contact area, thus reducing frictional force. • Though lubricants may be used, the main principle is rolling over reduced contact area. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A microphone is a device in which the

options.a: Sound waves are converted into electrical energy and then reconverted into sound after transmission
options.c: Electrical energy is converted into sound waves directly
options.d: Amplification is not required at all

explanation: • A microphone acts as a transducer that converts sound waves into electrical energy. • The electrical signal is then transmitted or amplified. • Later, a speaker performs the reverse process, converting the electrical signal back into sound. • Therefore, the microphone’s function is part of the sound-to-electric-to-sound transmission process. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Ice cubes are floating in a glass of water. When the ice cubes melt, the water level in the glass

options.a: Will first increase and then start decreasing
options.b: Will first decrease and then start increasing

explanation: • This is explained by Archimedes’ principle. • A floating object displaces a volume of water equal in weight to itself. • The ice cube displaces a volume of water whose weight equals the weight of the ice. • When the ice melts, it turns into water of the same weight, occupying the same displaced volume. • Thus, the water level remains constant. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which of the following pairs is not correct?

options.c: Hygrometer – Water vapour content of the atmosphere

explanation: • (a) Seismograph – measures earthquakes → Correct. • (b) Anemometer – measures wind speed → Correct. • (c) Hygrometer – measures humidity → Correct. • (d) Lactometer – measures purity/density of milk, not general liquid density → Incorrect. • The instrument for specific gravity of liquids in general is a hydrometer. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Radio waves travel with a speed of
explanation: • Radio waves are a form of electromagnetic radiation. • • • All electromagnetic waves — including light, X-rays, microwaves, and radio waves — travel at the speed of light in a vacuum. The speed of light (c) = 3 × 10⁸ m/s. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Atmospheric temperature increases at the higher altitudes due to
explanation: • Normally, in the troposphere, temperature decreases as altitude increases (the normal lapse rate). • Temperature inversion is a phenomenon where this normal pattern is reversed, and a layer of warmer air sits on top of a layer of cooler air. • Inversions can trap pollutants and are common on clear, calm nights. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A small wooden block is floating in a tub of water. The water is gradually heated. The volume of the wooden block visible above the water level
explanation: • By Archimedes' principle, a floating object displaces a weight of fluid equal to its own weight; the block’s weight is constant. • • • • When water is heated, it expands and its density decreases. To support the same weight in less dense water, a larger submerged volume is required, so the block sinks deeper. Therefore, the visible part of the block above the water decreases. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: If a toy boat in a tank sinks, the level of water will
explanation: • While floating, the toy boat displaces a volume of water whose weight equals the boat’s weight. • When it sinks, it is fully submerged and displaces a volume equal to the solid material of the boat (not the larger volume it displaced while floating). • Since the floating displacement was larger (boat is hollow), when it sinks it displaces less water, so the water level decreases. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Black hole

options.c: Absorbs all the radiations that fall on it
options.d: Is an imaginary concept in Physics

explanation: • A black hole has a gravitational field so intense that nothing, not even light, can escape from it. • Because nothing can escape, a black hole effectively absorbs all radiation that falls on it, appearing perfectly black. • (Note: Hawking radiation is a theoretical exception over extremely long timescales, but the defining property is absorption.) • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which of the following is the correct sequence in order of increasing power consumption?

options.a: Television, Fan, Electric Kettle, Electric Iron
options.b: Television, Fan, Electric Iron, Electric Kettle
options.c: Fan, Television, Electric Kettle, Electric Iron
options.d: Fan, Television, Electric Iron, Electric Kettle

explanation: • Typical power ranges (approximate): Fan (~50–100 W) < Television (~100–200 W) < Electric Iron (~1000–1500 W) < Electric Kettle (~1500–3000 W). • Therefore, the increasing sequence is Fan < Television < Electric Iron < Electric Kettle. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: To increase the voltage of an alternating current, we can use
explanation: • A transformer transfers electrical energy between circuits by electromagnetic induction and can increase (step-up) or decrease (step-down) AC voltages. • A capacitor stores energy, an inverter converts DC → AC, and a rectifier converts AC → DC. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Assertion (A): Solar eclipse occurs on a new moon day. Reason (R): Moon is in conjunction with the sun.

options.a: if A and R both are correct and R is the correct explanation of A
options.b: if A and R both are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.c: if A is correct and R is incorrect
options.d: if A is incorrect and R is correct

explanation: • A is true: a solar eclipse happens when the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth, which occurs at New Moon. • • • R is true: the Moon being in conjunction with the Sun means it is aligned between Earth and Sun. R correctly explains A, since this alignment (conjunction) is the condition for a solar eclipse. Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Assertion (A): Comets have gaseous tails. Reason (R): They are very hot bodies.

options.a: if A and R both are correct and R is the correct explanation of A
options.b: if A and R both are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.c: if A is correct and R is incorrect
options.d: if A is incorrect and R is correct

explanation: • A is true: comets develop gaseous tails of gas and dust when near the Sun. • R is false: comets are not inherently hot bodies; they are composed of ice and dust. • The tail forms because solar radiation causes sublimation of ices and the solar wind pushes the gas/dust away, not because the comet itself is hot. • Therefore, A is correct and R is incorrect. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which of the following groups of instruments is required to have a communication line between two television relay centres?

options.a: Microwave link, telephone, booster relay, satellite
options.b: Radio telescope, microwave link, booster relay, telephone

explanation: • To transmit a television signal over a long distance between two relay centers, a combination of technologies is used. • Microwave link: This is used for line-of-sight terrestrial communication over shorter to medium distances. The signal is transmitted from one tower to another. • Booster relay: These are repeaters or amplifiers placed along the communication path to boost the signal strength and compensate for attenuation over distance. • Satellite: For very long distances or to overcome geographical obstacles, the signal is sent up to a communication satellite, which then re-transmits it down to the receiving relay center. • A telephone is a terminal device for voice communication and a radio telescope is for astronomy; neither is a core part of the transmission infrastructure between relay centers. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The ozone layer of the atmosphere absorbs
explanation: • The ozone layer, located in the stratosphere, plays a crucial role in protecting life on Earth. • Its primary function is to absorb the majority of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation, particularly the more dangerous UVB and UVC wavelengths. • By absorbing this radiation, the ozone layer prevents it from reaching the Earth's surface, where it can cause skin cancer, cataracts, and damage to plant and animal life. • • Infrared rays are associated with heat, and cosmic rays are high-energy particles from space. Hence, option (a) is correct. • •

subject: General Science
question: The fuel used in the Fast Breeder Test Reactor at Kalpakkam is
explanation: • The Fast Breeder Test Reactor (FBTR) at the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR) in Kalpakkam is a key part of India's three-stage nuclear power program. • Unlike conventional reactors that use enriched uranium, a fast breeder reactor is designed to "breed" more fissile material than it consumes. • The FBTR was designed to use a mixed carbide fuel of plutonium and uranium. The initial core was loaded with weapons-grade plutonium, making it the fuel for this type of reactor. • Thorium is used in the third stage of India's nuclear program. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which of the following is a conventional source of energy?
explanation: • Conventional sources of energy are those that have been in common use for a long time and are typically non-renewable (like fossil fuels) or are large-scale and well-established renewable sources. • Hydropower, especially from large dams, has been used for electricity generation on a massive scale for over a century and is considered a conventional source of energy. Geothermal, solar, and wind energy, while renewable, are generally classified as nonconventional or alternative energy sources because their large-scale use is more recent. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Acceleration due to gravity on the moon is 0.166 times that on the earth. A man weighing 60 kg on earth would weigh ------kg on the moon.
explanation: • This question contains a common confusion between mass and weight. • The man's mass is 60 kg. Mass is the amount of matter in an object and it remains constant regardless of location. • Weight is the force of gravity acting on that mass (Weight = mass × g). The unit of weight is the Newton (N). The question incorrectly asks for weight in kg, but it clearly intends to find the apparent weight or the mass that would produce the same force on Earth. • Weight on Earth = 60 kg × g_earth. • Weight on Moon = 60 kg × g_moon = 60 kg × (0.166 × g_earth) ≈ 9.96 × g_earth. • This means on the Moon, the man would feel as if he weighed approximately 10 kg on Earth. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Resistance of a 100-watt bulb is R₁ and that of a 60-watt bulb is R₂. Which of the following is correct?
explanation: • The relationship between power (P), voltage (V), and resistance (R) is given by the formula P = V²/R. • This can be rearranged to R = V²/P. • • • • Assuming both bulbs operate at the same standard voltage (V), their resistance is inversely proportional to their power rating (R ∝ 1/P). This means the bulb with the higher power rating (100 W) will have the lower resistance, and the bulb with the lower power rating (60 W) will have the higher resistance. Therefore, R₁ (100W) is less than R₂ (60W), so R₁/R₂ < 1. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A man coming down in a lift leaves a ball from his hand. The ball will

options.c: Remain stationary with respect to the man

explanation: • This question describes the principle of relativity of motion. • When the man releases the ball, both he and the ball are already moving downwards with the same velocity as the lift. • Assuming the lift is moving at a constant velocity (not accelerating or decelerating), both the man and the ball will continue to be affected by gravity in the same way. • Since they both start with the same downward velocity and are subject to the same downward acceleration (g), their relative positions will not change. • Therefore, from the man's perspective, the ball will appear to remain stationary with respect to him. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The stars receive their energy from which of the following?
explanation: • • • • • Stars, including our Sun, are powered by nuclear fusion occurring in their cores. Under the immense pressure and extreme temperatures found in the core of a star, lighter atomic nuclei (primarily hydrogen) are forced together to form heavier nuclei (like helium). This fusion process releases a vast amount of energy in the form of light and heat, which is what makes stars shine. Nuclear fission is the splitting of heavy atoms, and chemical reactions release far too little energy to power a star. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Reading of the barometer going down is an indication of
explanation: • A barometer measures atmospheric pressure. • A falling or "going down" barometer indicates that the atmospheric pressure is decreasing. • Low pressure systems are associated with rising air, which cools and condenses to form clouds and precipitation. • Therefore, a falling barometer is a classic indication of approaching bad weather, such as rainfall or a storm. A rapid or sudden drop often indicates a storm (a), but rainfall (b) is the more general and certain outcome of falling pressure. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Distribution of electric power from one place to another is done at high A.C. voltage because

options.b: Stealing of electric wires is prevented
options.c: Electricity spreads in a very short time

explanation: • When electricity is transmitted over long distances through power lines, some energy is lost as heat due to the electrical resistance of the wires. This power loss is given by P_loss = I²R, where I is the current and R is the resistance. • To transmit a certain amount of power (P = V × I), if you increase the voltage (V), you can decrease the current (I) for the same amount of power. • By transmitting at a very high voltage, the current is kept very low. Since power loss is proportional to the square of the current (I²), this dramatically reduces the amount of energy lost as heat. • Therefore, transmitting at high AC voltage minimises the wastage of electricity. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: An astronaut weighing 100 kg fires a bullet weighing 1 kg with a gun of 10 kg at the speed of 50 metres/second. What will be the recoil velocity of the gun?
explanation: • This problem is an application of the law of conservation of linear momentum. The total momentum of the system (astronaut + gun + • • • • • • • • • • bullet) before firing is zero. Therefore, the total momentum after firing must also be zero. The astronaut's mass is irrelevant if we are only considering the recoil of the gun relative to the astronaut. Let's assume the question means the recoil of the gun held by the astronaut. The total mass recoiling is the mass of the astronaut plus the gun. Let M = mass of astronaut + gun = 100 kg + 10 kg = 110 kg. Let m = mass of bullet = 1 kg. Let V = recoil velocity of the astronaut and gun. Let v = velocity of the bullet = 50 m/s. Conservation of momentum: (Momentum of astronaut+gun) + (Momentum of bullet) = 0 → M × V + m × v = 0. 110 × V + 1 × 50 = 0 → 110 × V = -50 → V = -50 / 110 ≈ -0.4545 m/s. The negative sign indicates direction opposite to the bullet. Converting to cm/s: -0.4545 m/s × 100 cm/m = -45.45 cm/s. This is approximately 50 cm/

subject: General Science
question: To a person on the moon, the sky appears
explanation: • This is similar to previous questions about sky colour. The sky appears blue on Earth due to the scattering of sunlight by the molecules in our atmosphere (Rayleigh scattering). • The Moon has no significant atmosphere. • Without an atmosphere to scatter sunlight, an observer on the Moon would see the Sun as a very bright star in a completely black sky, even during the lunar day. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Neutron was discovered by
explanation: • In 1932, the English physicist James Chadwick conducted experiments proving the existence of a neutral particle within the atomic nucleus. • He identified this particle — similar in mass to a proton but with no electrical charge — and named it the neutron. • This discovery was a landmark in nuclear physics and completed the basic atomic model (protons, neutrons, electrons). • Chadwick was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics (1935) for this discovery. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Let E₁, E₂, E₃ denote the efficiency of a diesel, a petrol, and a steam engine respectively. Which of the following is correct?
explanation: • Steam engines (E₃) are external combustion engines with the lowest efficiency (≈15–20%) due to large heat losses. • Petrol (gasoline) engines (E₂) are internal combustion engines with moderate efficiency (≈25–30%). • Diesel engines (E₁) operate at higher compression ratios and therefore have higher thermal efficiency (≈40–45%). • Thus the order is Diesel > Petrol > Steam, i.e., E₁ > E₂ > E₃. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The resolving power of an electron microscope is much higher than that of an ordinary light microscope because resolving power increases

options.a: If the wavelength is short and the wavelength of the electron beam can be made quite small by accelerating the electrons.
options.b: If the wavelength is short and light given by electrons has very short wavelength.
options.c: If magnification is high and electronic lens provides much higher magnification
options.d: If magnification is high and the electron microscope has a battery of lenses to provide high magnification.

explanation: • Resolving power depends fundamentally on the wavelength of the illuminating radiation — shorter wavelength → higher resolution. • A light microscope uses visible light (wavelengths ~400–700 nm). • An electron microscope uses accelerated electrons, whose de Broglie wavelength can be made extremely short by high acceleration (much shorter than visible light). • That very short wavelength is the primary reason for the vastly superior resolving power of electron microscopes. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation broadcasts its programmes on the 25-metre band. Which one of the following is the frequency of this transmission?
explanation: • Wave speed relation: c = f × λ, where c ≈ 3 × 10⁸ m/s and λ = 25 m. • Frequency: f = c / λ = (3 × 10⁸) / 25 = 1.2 × 10⁷ Hz = 12 × 10⁶ Hz = 12 MHz. • Therefore the 25-metre band corresponds to ~12 Mega Hertz (MHz). • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: If camera A has an f/4.5 lens and camera B has an f/2.8 lens, and the diameters of both the lenses are equal, then

options.a: Pictures taken by A will always be sharper.
options.b: Pictures taken by B will always be sharper.
options.c: A is better for photographing fast-moving objects.
options.d: B is better for photographing fast-moving objects.

explanation: • The f-number (e.g., f/4.5, f/2.8) is the ratio of focal length to aperture diameter; a lower fnumber = wider aperture. • A wider aperture (lower f-number) allows more light, enabling faster shutter speeds for the same exposure. • Faster shutter speeds help freeze motion, so a camera with f/2.8 (B) is better for photographing fast-moving objects. • Sharpness depends on many factors (lens quality, depth of field), not just f-number. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Seawater is saltier than rainwater because

options.b: Rivers wash away salts from the earth and pour them into the sea.
options.c: The air around the sea is saltish.

explanation: • Rain erodes rocks on land, dissolving minerals and salts. • Rivers and streams carry these dissolved salts into the oceans. • When water evaporates from the ocean, the salts remain behind, causing gradual accumulation of salt over geological time. • This continuous cycle makes the seawater salty, whereas rainwater is relatively pure. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A free-floating astronaut 'A' pushes another freefloating astronaut 'B' in space. The mass of 'A' is greater than that of 'B'. The force exerted by the astronaut 'A' on the astronaut 'B' will be

options.b: Equal to the force exerted by 'B' on 'A'.
options.c: Greater than the force exerted by 'B' on 'A'.
options.d: Less than the force exerted by 'B' on 'A'.

explanation: • By Newton's Third Law, every action has an equal and opposite reaction. • When A pushes B, B pushes A with an equal magnitude force in the opposite direction. • The masses affect the resulting accelerations (F = m·a) — the less massive astronaut will experience greater acceleration — but the forces are equal and opposite. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: On the Moon, an astronaut inflates a rubber balloon with hydrogen gas and releases it at a height of 2 metres. The balloon will

options.c: Remain at the height of 2 metres
options.d: First go up and finally come down

explanation: • Buoyancy requires a surrounding fluid (atmosphere); an object rises if it is less dense than the fluid it displaces. • The Moon has no significant atmosphere (essentially a vacuum), so no buoyant force will act on the balloon. • With no air to displace, the only significant force is the Moon’s gravity, so the balloon will fall down. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The phenomenon of mirage is due to

options.a: Increased absorption of light by air at higher temperature
options.b: Change in the refractive index of air with the change in temperature
options.d: Decreased absorption of light by air at higher temperature

explanation: • A mirage occurs because layers of air at different temperatures have different densities, thus different refractive indices. • Light rays bend (refract) when passing through these layers; on hot surfaces the refractive index gradient can bend rays • • upwards, making distant sky or objects appear as reflections on the ground. While total internal reflection can sometimes be involved, the fundamental cause is the change in refractive index with temperature. Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The limit beyond which stars suffer internal collapse is called
explanation: • The Chandrasekhar limit (~1.4 solar masses) is the maximum mass a white dwarf can have while being supported by electron degeneracy pressure. • If a white dwarf exceeds this limit, electron degeneracy pressure fails and the star can collapse, possibly leading to a supernova or formation of a neutron star. • The Eddington limit concerns maximum luminosity before radiation pressure overcomes gravity. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A boat filled with some stones is floating in water. If the stones are dropped into the water, the level of the water will
explanation: • This is a classic physics problem involving Archimedes' Principle. • Case 1 (stones in the boat): the floating boat displaces a volume of water whose weight equals the combined weight of the boat and stones. • Case 2 (stones in the water): the stones displace water equal to their own volume, and the boat now displaces less water. • Because stones are much denser than water, the submerged volume they occupy is much less than the volume they caused the boat to displace while onboard. • Therefore the total displaced volume (and thus the water level) decreases when the stones are dropped overboard. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Total internal reflection occurs when light travels from

options.a: A rarer medium to a denser medium
options.b: A denser medium to a rarer medium
options.c: A rarer medium to a denser medium and the angle of incidence is less than the critical angle.
options.d: A rarer medium to a denser medium and the angle of incidence is greater than the critical angle.

explanation: • Total Internal Reflection (TIR) occurs when light tries to pass from a denser medium to a rarer medium (e.g., glass → air). • A second necessary condition is that the angle of incidence exceeds the critical angle for that interface. • Option (b) correctly identifies the required direction of travel for TIR to be possible. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A chair is tilted about two of its legs and then left. It would return to its original position if

options.a: Its centre of gravity falls outside the base.
options.b: Its centre of gravity falls within the base.
options.c: It is tilted through an angle of 60°.

explanation: • Stability depends on the position of the centre of gravity (CG) relative to the base of support. • If the vertical line from the CG falls within the base, the object is stable and will return to its original position. • If the CG moves outside the base, the object becomes unstable and will topple. • Hence, option (b) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Very small-time intervals are accurately measured by the
explanation: • Atomic clocks use the resonant frequency of atoms (e.g., caesium-133) as their timekeeping standard. • The atomic oscillations are extremely regular, allowing measurement of very small time intervals with outstanding precision. • Quartz clocks are accurate but less precise than atomic clocks; pulsars are astronomical timekeepers but not standard instruments for general use. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Insolation refers to

options.a: Restraining the flow of electric current
options.c: Exposure to the rays of the sun

explanation: • • • Insolation = incoming solar radiation; it denotes the amount of solar energy reaching a surface. It is a key meteorological/climatological term that quantifies exposure to the Sun's rays. Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Which of the following is true?

options.c: Both the light and sound waves exhibit interference.
options.d: Neither sound waves nor light waves exhibit interference.

explanation: • Interference is a fundamental property of waves—it occurs when two or more waves superpose. • Both sound and light are wave phenomena and therefore exhibit interference, giving rise to constructive and destructive patterns. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Heat from the sun is received by the earth through
explanation: • The space between the Sun and Earth is essentially a vacuum, so conduction and convection cannot transfer heat across it. • Energy travels as electromagnetic radiation (visible light, infrared, UV), which does not require a medium. • Thus the Earth receives the Sun’s heat by radiation. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: 'Black holes' refers to
explanation: • A black hole is the result of a massive star's gravitational collapse, producing an object of extremely high density. • Its gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape from within its event horizon. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Atmospheric pressure exerted on earth is due to the
explanation: • Atmospheric pressure is the force per unit area due to the weight of the air column above a surface. • The Earth’s gravity holds the atmosphere and causes the air mass above to exert pressure on the surface. • Hence, option (c) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: A small weight put on the pressure cooker increases the pressure of steam because

options.b: Area of contact is very small
options.c: Density of metal is very high
options.d: The weight acts as a valve, trapping steam until a specific pressure is reached.

explanation: • The small weight sits on the cooker’s vent and functions as a pressure-regulating valve. • As steam builds, the weight traps it, allowing pressure to increase until the steam force lifts the weight and a pulse of steam escapes. • This mechanism maintains a constant elevated pressure and temperature for efficient cooking. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Birds get thrust (forward motion) and lift (upward motion) from the

options.c: Shape of wings which is similar to aeroplane blades

explanation: • Lift is largely generated by the airfoil shape of the wings (pressure difference top vs bottom), while thrust is produced mainly by the flapping motion. • The down-and-back stroke of flapping pushes air backward, producing forward thrust (Newton’s Third Law), and also contributes to additional lift. • While wing shape matters for lift, the flapping provides both primary thrust and dynamic lift needed in active flight. • Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The conversion of electrical energy into chemical energy is observed in
explanation: • A fan converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. • A heater converts electrical energy into thermal energy. • An incandescent bulb converts electrical energy into heat and light. • A storage battery, on the other hand, converts electrical energy into chemical energy through oxidation at the anode and reduction at the cathode. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: The evidence for the rotation of stars comes mainly from the
explanation: • • • • The Doppler Effect refers to the change in frequency or wavelength of waves (sound or light) due to the relative motion between the source and observer. In astronomy, the red shift (movement away) and blue shift (movement toward) of light from stars provide evidence of their rotation and motion. The expanding universe theory and details about galactic rotation are derived from Doppler shift observations. Hence, option (a) is correct.

subject: General Science
question: Assertion (A): A tennis ball will bounce higher in Calcutta than it would in Shimla. Reason (R): The downward pull due to gravity is less and air is more rarefied in Shimla than in Calcutta.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not a correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

explanation: • The force of gravity is slightly less at higher altitudes because they are farther from the Earth’s center. • Shimla, being at a higher altitude than Calcutta, has weaker gravity. • Therefore, a tennis ball would bounce higher in Shimla, not in Calcutta. • The assertion is false, but the reason (less gravity and rarer air at higher altitude) is true. • Hence, option (d) is correct.

subject: General Science
